notes.title: Friday Update - Demo Patches
notes.content: [p]Hey Cozy Beach Fishers![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a very exciting week for our dev team - we've been working hard on the demo and were very excited to see it released on Monday for Steam's Fishing Fest.  We got some amazing placement in the festival and are really glad we participated![/p][p][/p][p]We've also been patching the game- our dev has been hard at work finding solutions to the little bugs that popped up at the last second.  The demo is in good shape, we still have some bugs to fix here and there - details are below, and see [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3489070?emclan=103582791475002000&emgid=511835551706382400"]our post on Weds[/url] for more patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll continue to work on patching the bugs for this initial version of the demo, and shortly after that we'll start to add in some new exciting features!  Controller and Steam Deck support, character customization, NPC quests, more fish, emotes, apparel, silly emotes and more are planned to be rolled out over the year.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye on the game for updates, or [url="https://https://www.lunabeat.com/list_cb.php"]sign up to our newsletter here[/url] to get notified when we launch a new cool update![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions about the game, reach out to us [url="mailto:mail@lunabeat.com"]via email[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/dREkEjC3TY"]join or Discord.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for checking out your game, have a chill weekend, and we'll see you soon with more updates![/p][p][/p][p]🎁 Features Added[/p][p]-Fish inventory shows the number of fish you have caught so far[/p][p]-Volume sliders for master volume, music and sound effects added to options (press Esc to access options)[/p][p][/p][p]🐛 Bugs patched[/p][p]-Chatbox improvements[/p][p][/p][p]🐝 Bugs we're aware of and working to fix[/p][p]-Sometimes the camera snaps to look at nearby scenery and you lose your character, we believe this is a timeout bug, patching soon[/p][p]-If you're close to an NPC on someone else's island, the keyboard controls remain active with the chatbox when typing[/p][p]-If you jump on top of another cat and try to fish while standing on their head, your avatar's pose is frozen[/p][p]-Sometimes the font changes to another font for random letters (pretty sure this is fixed)[/p]

notes.title: Cozy Beach Demo Launch! Patch notes & fixes to come
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]What an exciting week!  Our lil' indie team has been hard at work for months prepping the Cozy Beach demo, and we're so thrilled that it's available for everyone to play now![/p][p][/p][p]Our goal for this initial version of the demo was to give everyone a taste of the vibe we're going for, and some fun basic fishing and chatting features.[/p][p][/p][p]Some dev notes:[/p][p]We patched a few bugs this week, and have plans to patch a few more!  Details are below.[/p][p]We also have plans to update the demo as we develop the game!  Keep your eyes out for updates this year with customizable characters, apparel, more interactive NPCs, more fish and emotes, apparel, collectibles, crafting and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you also for your patience with stray bugs as we get everything ironed out and working smoothly 🙏 we'll be posting patch notes as we go with what gets fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]We also welcome your feedback about the demo!  Here's a [url="https://forms.gle/JFpCrKAxUFADWf4W8"]feedback form[/url], or just hit reply on this and let us know.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for checking out Cozy Beach and for playing the demo!  We hope you have a great time, and hope to see you back soon for more with future updates! 😸[/p][p][i]-LunaBeat[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🐛 Bugs patched this week[/b][/p][p]-Bug where you fell forever when joining an island fixed[/p][p]-Bug where you spawned under the sand fixed[/p][p]-Bug where your avatar froze after an animation fixed[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where you froze in place on spawn[/p][p]-Sometimes the fishing line will get caught on something, or fish will get trapped under the ground - we added a "Cut the line" feature to escape situations like these[/p][p]-The emote wheel persisted sometimes without a way to dismiss it, we made it so pressing "Esc" clears the emote wheel[/p][p]-Changed the text color in the chat balloon to make it easier to read[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where a 2nd player joining an island would have their controls remapped from keyboard & mouse to an Xbox controller (??)[/p][p]-Little boot icons from the chatters list would persist on the player screen[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐝 Bugs we're aware of and working to fix[/b][/p][p]-In multiplayer, the chatbox "grabs" the controls from players and moves their avatars while typing (WASD & spacebar)[/p][p]-If you jump on top of another cat and try to fish while standing on their head, your avatar's pose is frozen[/p][p]-Audio balancing - we'll be adding volume sliders for music, sound effects and overall volume soon[/p][p]-Sometimes the font changes to another font for random letters[/p][p]-Sometimes the camera snaps to look at nearby scenery and you lose your character (this might be fixed, I am not 100% sure)[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐞Bugs we might leave cause they're hilarious[/b][/p][p]-If you use an emote to lie on the ground, you can both jump and fish while lying down.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing Cozy Beach!! 🏝😸[/p]
